name: Motto Haramasete Valkyrie
original_name: もっとハラマセテ戦乙女（ヴァルキリー）
source:
Yngvi is a secret elf. He left his homeland and travels around the world. One day, he sees three beautiful valkyries and plans to make them his sex slaves. Loki gives him a special bracelet and says to him, "If you make them your sex slaves, I'll make you half God and half elf." By using the bracelet, Yngvi shags with the pure and brave valkyries....

[From ErogeShop]
